https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: last reported price at which a security was sold
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: arithmetic mean between bid and offer prices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mid price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price suggested by a prospective seller at a particular time for a given security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: offer price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price of the final trade of a security at the end of a trading day on a given exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: official closing price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price at which something first trades at the start of a trading day
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: opening price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure involving security prices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price analytic

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: strategy for calculating or otherwise establishing a price for something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price determination method

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: difference between two prices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price spread

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expression used to determine a value for an instrument at a given point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pricing model

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: net gain or loss on an investment over a specified time period, expressed as a percentage of the investment's initial cost or value as of a specific point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rate of return

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: monetary price for a financial instrument at some point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time span that a particular trading venue is open
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trading day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: window of time within a trading day in which orders may be placed and filled
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trading session

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: average price at which a given security has traded throughout a trading day, determined by multiplying each trade by its volume, adding the results, then dividing by the volume traded for the day
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: volume-weighted average price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price determined by multiplying each trade by its volume, adding the results, then dividing by the volume over a certain period during the trading day (rather than over the course of the entire day)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: volume-weighted open price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: return on the investor's capital investment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: yield

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the spread between the yields of two items
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: yield spread

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual commitment to settle in cash
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cash settlement terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: method and commitment to transfer a commodity, currency, security, cash or another instrument as defined in the settlement terms of the contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery method

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment to deliver the actual underlying asset on the specified delivery date, rather than cash
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical settlement terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: act of finalizing a transaction, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: settlement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention employed to determine the closing date (from the stated settlement date) in the process of settling a transaction on which securities or interests in securities are delivered, usually against (in simultaneous exchange for) payment of some consideration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: settlement convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specific event involving the finalization a transaction or portion thereof, including but not limited to finalizing accounting, exchanging consideration, and/or legally recording documents, as applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: settlement event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code used to denote a metropolitan area where business is conducted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business center code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: coding scheme used to define a set of codes for municipalities or business centers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business center code set

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code used to denote a convention for specifying what happens when a date falls on a day that is weekend or holiday in some municipality or business center
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day adjustment code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies a business register, such as a register identified by the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) registration authorities list
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business register identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registration authority that is responsible for maintaining a registry of business entities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business registration authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry for registering and maintaining information about business entities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a business registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code for the reason that a legal entity ceased to exist and/or operate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity expiration reason

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry for registering and maintaining information about the legal forms that are valid for business entities for a particular jurisdiction following the ISO 20275 standard
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity legal form registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in an entity legal form registry that conforms to ISO 20275
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity legal form registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lifecycle stage indicating the operational and/or legal status of an entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code for the level of validation performed by the GLEIF or LOU with respect to the reference data provided by the registrant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity validation level

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry for registering and maintaining information about business entities for a particular jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal entity identifier registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a legal entity identifier registry that conforms to ISO 17442 and the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) Common Data Format (CDF)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal entity identifier registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registrar that is authorized by the Global LEI Foundation to issue legal entity identifiers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: local operating unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code representing an industry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: North American Industry Classification System code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the scheme defining the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Codes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: North American Industry Classification System scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies a business registry, and is associated with a registration authority and jurisdiction, issued by the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registration authority code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lifecycle stage indicating the status of a given registration of something, such as a business or legal entity, as specified by the registration authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registration status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the SIC code representing an industry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standard industrial classification code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the scheme defining the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) Code List
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standard industrial classification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an undertaking whose business is to receive deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account as defined by the European Banking Authority (EBA)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CRD credit institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an undertaking the business of which is to take deposits or other repayable funds from the public and to grant credits for its own account, and to which authorisation has been granted to operate within the European Union and European Economic Area countries (EEA)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification specific to European financial institutions that designates them as credit institutions / investment firms as defined by the European Banking Authority (EBA)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit institution / investment firm

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a branch of a credit institution authorised in another European Economic Area (EEA) country that has the right to passport its activities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: European Economic Area branch

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any legal person whose regular occupation or business is the provision of one or more investment services to third parties and/or the performance of one or more investment activities on a professional basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment firm

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a firm dealing for its own account on markets in financial futures or options or other derivatives and on cash markets for the sole purpose of hedging positions on derivatives markets, or dealing for the accounts of other members of those markets and being guaranteed by clearing members of the same markets, where responsibility for ensuring the performance of contracts entered into by such a firm is assumed by clearing members of the same markets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: local firm

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a branch of a credit institution whose Head Office is in a third country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non European Economic Area branch

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a legal person that has been granted authorisation in accordance with Article 10 to provide and execute payment services throughout the European community
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in the Credit Institution Register, a repository of credit institutions collected by the European Banking Authority (EBA) as provided by the various national banking authorities for those institutions that qualify
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Credit Institution Register entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: depository institution, usually a corporation, that accepts deposits, makes loans, pays checks, and performs related services, for individual members of the public, businesses or other organizations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any company that owns and/or has direct or indirect control of one or more banks; BHCs may also own nonbanking subsidiaries such as broker-dealers and asset managers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bank holding company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product provided to consumers and businesses by a depository institution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: banking product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service offered by a depository institution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: banking service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: firm in the business of buying and selling securities, operating as both a broker and a dealer, depending on the transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: brokerage firm

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: international identifier for financial and non-financial institutions used to facilitate automated processing of information for financial services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business identifier code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme that specifies the elements of a unique business identifier code (BIC) scheme to identify financial and non-financial institutions used to facilitate automated processing of information for financial services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business identifier code scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: four-character (4 alphanumeric) code associated with an organization for the purposes of banking telecommunications
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business party prefix

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: two-character (2 alphanumeric) code associated with the organization for the purposes of banking telecommunications
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business party suffix

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that is the monetary authority and major regulatory bank for a country (or group of countries)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: central bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: clearing house that helps facilitate trading in derivatives and equities markets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: central counterparty clearing house

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: functional entity that provides a central point for depositing financial instruments ('securities'), for example, bonds and shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: central securities depository

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commercial bank that facilitates payment and settlement of financial transactions, such as check clearing or facilitating trades between the sellers and buyers of securities or other financial instruments or contracts
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clearing bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: clearing house that is organized as a corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clearing corporation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider that is exchange affiliated and provides clearing services, including the validation, delivery, and settlement of financial transactions, for financial intermediaries
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clearing house

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: service provided on behalf of an institutional market participant by a clearing services provider following a trade that finalizes the transfer of security ownership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clearing service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: depository institution that engages in various financial services, such as accepting deposits and making loans
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commercial bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: finance company that makes loans to manufacturers and wholesalers, secured by accounts receivable, inventories, and equipment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commercial finance company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that directly or indirectly advises others as to the value or advisability of buying or selling futures contracts or options
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commodity trading advisor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: finance company that lends to individuals under the small loans laws of the jurisdiction in which they operate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer finance company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that provides the opportunity for individuals to invest in collective investment vehicles in a fiduciary rather than a principle role
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual savings institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit depository institution that makes personal loans and offers other consumer banking services, organized for the purpose of promoting thrift among its members and creating a source of credit for provident or productive purposes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit union

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service offered by an entity primarily engaged in providing infrastructure for hosting or data processing services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: data processing service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: finance services provider primarily engaged in providing infrastructure for hosting or data processing services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: data processing service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any financial institution engaged in the business of receiving demand deposits from the public or other institutions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: depository institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: national or regional financial institution designed to provide medium- and long-term capital for productive investment, often accompanied by technical assistance, in poor countries
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: development bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: service involving any transfer of funds other than a transaction involving a paper instrument, that is initiated through an electronic terminal, telephone, or computer and that orders or authorizes a financial institution to debit or credit an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: electronic funds transfer service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment company which is engaged or proposes to engage in the business of issuing face-amount certificates of the installment type, or which has been engaged in such business and has any such certificate outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: face amount certificate company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial intermediary in the business of making loans that obtains its financing from banks, institutions, and other money market sources rather than from deposits
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finance company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider identified as either a government agency or privately owned entity that collects funds from the public and from other institutions, and invests those funds in financial assets, such as loans, securities, bank deposits, and income-generating property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that is officially allocated to a financial service provider based on a function that they provide, typically in a jurisdiction over which a regulatory agency has some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial service provider identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme that defines the financial service provider identifier per the issuing registration authority or regulatory agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial service provider identifier scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that does both of the following: (1) solicits or accepts orders to buy or sell futures contracts, options on futures, retail off-exchange forex contracts, or swaps and (2) accepts money or other assets from customers to support such orders
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: futures commission merchant

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: business entity established to own stock in another company, typically to own enough voting shares to have some level of control over that company's policies and management
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: holding company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: non-depository institution whose primary and predominant business activity is the writing of insurance or the reinsuring of risks underwritten by insurance companies, and that provides compensation based on the happening of at least one contingency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: insurance company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service in which the insurer promises to provide compensation for specific potential future losses in exchange for a periodic payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: insurance service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider that acts as an underwriter or agent that serves as intermediary between the issuer of securities and the investing public
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any issuer which: (a) is or holds itself out as being engaged primarily, or proposes to engage primarily, in the business of investing, reinvesting, or trading in securities; (b) is engaged or proposes to engage in the business of issuing face-amount certificates of the installment type, or has been engaged in such business and has any such certificate outstanding; or (c) is engaged or proposes to engage in the business of investing, reinvesting, owning, holding, or trading in securities, and owns or proposes to acquire investment securities having a value exceeding 40 per centum of the value of such issuer's total assets (exclusive of Government securities and cash items) on an unconsolidated basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service designed to assist investors in using capital to create more money, either through income-producing vehicles or through more risk-oriented ventures to result in capital gains, including but not limited to providing investment advice, asset and portfolio management, and brokerage services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment company that sells and manages a portfolio of securities other than a face-amount certificate company or unit investment fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: management company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provided by a financial institution to a merchant or other business, including but not limited to managing financial transactions via a secure channel
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merchant service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: regulatory agency that controls the monetary policy, regulation and supply of money in some country or group of countries
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: monetary authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any person doing business, whether or not on a regular basis or as an organized business concern, in one of the following capacities: (1) currency dealer or exchanger, (2) check casher, (3) issuer of traveler's checks, money orders, or stored value, (4) seller or redeemer of traveler's checks, money orders, or stored value, (5) money transmitter, or (6) postal service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: money services business

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider that originates and/or funds mortgages for residential or commercial property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that does not have a full banking license and typically is not supervised by a national or international banking regulatory agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-depository institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service that involves acceptance of electronic payments by a variety of payment methods including credit card, bank-based payments such as direct debit, bank transfer, and real-time bank transfer based on online banking
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service, typically provided to small businesses that are not large enough to have an internal finance organization, that involves managing payment of wages to employees
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payroll service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: underwriter who, as principal, purchases from an investment company, or pursuant to some contract has the right to purchase from such company, any security for distribution, or who as agent for such company sells or has the right to sell any security to a dealer or to the public, excluding any dealer who purchases from such company through sn underwriter acting as an agent for such company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: principal underwriter

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registered agent and financial service provider that advises high net worth individuals on investments and manages their portfolios
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registered investment advisor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that provides some financial service while spreading the financial risk inherent in that service to lower the probability of a catastrophic financial event by aggregating customers across diverse dimensions as a risk management practice
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: risk pooling institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: finance company that purchases retail and wholesale paper from automobile and other consumer and commercial goods dealers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sales finance company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: depository institution that is (a) any federal savings bank or association chartered under section 1464 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act; (b) any state chartered building and loan association, savings and loan association, or homestead association; or (c) any cooperative bank (other than a cooperative bank which is a state bank as defined in subsection (a)(2)) of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act, which is organized and operating according to the laws of the State (as defined in subsection (a)(3)) in which it is chartered or organized; and (c) any corporation (other than a bank) that the board of directors and the comptroller of the currency jointly determine to be operating in substantially the same manner as such a depository institution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: savings association

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: non-governmental organization that has the power to create and exercise some degree of regulatory authority over an industry or profession in some country or group of countries
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: self-regulating organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that acts as a fiduciary, trustee or agent of trusts and agencies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trust company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider that evaluates and assumes another party's risk for a fee, such as a commission, premium, spread or interest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriter

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual agreement between parties that commits the underwriter to assuming risk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriting arrangement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment company which (a) is organized under a trust indenture, contract of custodianship or agency, or similar instrument, (b) does not have a board of directors, and (c) issues only redeemable securities, each of which represents an undivided interest in a unit of specified securities; but does not include a voting trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit investment trust

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service that combines financial and investment advice, accounting and tax services, retirement planning and legal or estate planning for one set fee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: wealth management service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a registry that conforms to ISO 9362 for the management of BIC codes and related registration information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business identifier code data record

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a market identifier code registry that conforms to ISO 10383
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market identifier code registry entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading venue that is more loosely regulated than a regulated exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: alternative trading system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of publishing certain trade reports on behalf of banks, investment firms, or asset management companies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: approved publication arrangement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of reporting details of transactions to competent authorities or ESMA (the European Securities and Markets Authority) on behalf of investment firms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: approved reporting mechanism

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange in which buyers and sellers submit competitive bids that do not involve direct negotiations between parties, as part of an auction scheduled either on demand or on a periodic basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: auction market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of collecting trade reports for financial instruments from regulated markets, MTFs, OTFs and APAs and consolidating them into a continuous electronic live data stream providing price and volume data per financial instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consolidated tape provider

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial services provider that provides services for crypto assets that enable the control of crypto assets, and participate in, or provide, financial services for issuers' offers, or sale, of crypto assets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: crypto asset services provider

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: privately organized alternative trading system, that allows institutional investors the ability to trade without exposure until after the trade has been executed and reported
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dark pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider and reporting party that reports and/or publishes data on securities transactions, including required regulatory reporting for such transactions, and as such is subject to regulatory supervision
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: data reporting services provider

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange, trading system, or platform that enables listing for trading futures or option contracts based on any underlying commodity, index or instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: designated contract market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: alternative trading system that automatically matches buy and sell orders for securities in the market
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: electronic communication network

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any organization, association, or group of persons, whether incorporated or unincorporated, which constitutes, maintains, or provides a facility for bringing together purchasers and sellers of financial instruments, commodities, or other products, services, or goods, and includes the market place and facilities maintained by such exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registered agent who, in accordance with the rules of an exchange, may trade on or through the exchange and whose name is entered in a list, register or roll kept by the exchange as an agent who may trade on or through the exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange participant

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: automated system for organizing and disseminating price quotes by brokers and dealer firms that facilitates electronic trading in securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interdealer quotation system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier representing the controlled vocabulary that delineates the nature of the exchange or data reporting services provider where possible
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market category classifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that specifies a universal method of identifying exchanges, trading platforms, regulated or non-regulated markets, and data reporting services providers as sources of prices and related information in order to facilitate automated processing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lifecycle stage indicating the status of the MIC code, as specified by the registration authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market indicator code status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier that indicates whether the exchange or data reporting services provider is an operating level or market segment level facility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market level classifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: section of an exchange/market/trade reporting facility that specialises in one or more specific instruments or that is regulated differently
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market segment-level market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market identifier that identifies a section of an exchange/market/trade reporting facility that specialises in one or more specific instruments or that is regulated differently
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market segment-level market identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading system that facilitates the exchange of financial instruments between multiple parties
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: multilateral trading facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: facility used for reporting over-the-counter (OTC) and other direct trades that are not executed by the exchange but are reported through the exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: off-market facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange/market/trade reporting facility in a specific market/country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: operating-level market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market identifier that identifies an exchange/market/trade reporting facility in a specific market/country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: operating-level market identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: multi-lateral system which is not an RM or an MTF and in which multiple third-party buying and selling interests in bonds, structured finance products, emission allowances or derivatives are able to interact in the system in a way that results in a contract in accordance with the provisions of Title II of MiFID II
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organised trading facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange in which prices are determined from bid and ask quotations made by market makers, dealers, or specialists
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quote-driven market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange that is operated or maintained by an operator registered under certain securities regulations that brings together purchasers and sellers of capital market products
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: recognised market operator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: multilateral system operated by an investment firm or market operator, which brings together multiple third-party buying and selling interests in financial instruments in the system, in accordance with non-discretionary rules, in a way that results in a contract in accordance with the provisions of Title II of the MiFID II
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registered multilateral trading facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: regulated market that is operated by and/or managed by a market operator that brings together or facilitates the bringing together of multiple third-party buying and selling interests in financial instruments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulated exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange that enables participants to execute and trade swaps
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: swap execution facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment firm that, on an organised, frequent, systematic and substantial basis, deals on its own account by executing client orders outside a regulated exchange, MTF or OTF without operating a multilateral system
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: systematic internaliser

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: facility that provides a mechanism for the reporting of transactions effected otherwise than on an exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade reporting facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a not-for-profit financial institution, typically formed by the employees of a company, labor union, or religious group, operated as a cooperative association organized for the purpose of promoting thrift among its members and creating a source of credit for provident or productive purposes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian credit union

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique, 9-digit number that is the standard identifier for legal entities in Canada which are typically a business
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RC' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for reporting corporate income tax
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporation income tax number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RT' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for reporting GST/HST
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Goods and Services Tax / Harmonized Sales Tax registration number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RM' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for customs and import/export reporting purposes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: import export program number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: concatenation of an entity's business number, the 'RZ' abbreviation and a 4-digit subaccount number used for information returns

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: container for records associated with a business arrangement for regular transactions and services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial asset in the form of an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account as an asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that denotes an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: holding of an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account ownership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that provides and services an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account provider

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: service-agreement that is account-specific, applicable in cases where a client might hold multiple accounts with differing terms and conditions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account-specific service agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: periodic summary of account activity for a given period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: account statement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event recognized by an entry in the records of an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: accounting transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: amount of money available or owed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: balance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that identifies a demand deposit account provided by a bank
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bank account identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies the financial institution and, when appropriate, the branch of that financial institution servicing an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bank identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies an individual account at a specific financial institution in a particular country and which includes a bank identifier of the financial institution servicing that account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basic bank account identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account offered by a broker that allows the investor to deposit funds and place investment orders
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: brokerage account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cash instrument associated with a time deposit account that cannot be withdrawn for a certain period of time (term)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: certificate of deposit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date on which something was closed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: close date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: service involving the extension of credit to support business activities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commercial lending service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account that represents an identified, named collection of balances and cumulative totals used to summarize customer transaction-related activity over a designated period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: customer account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns a customer account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: customer account holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: non-interest-bearing deposit account in which deposits are payable immediately on demand, or that are issued with an original maturity or required notice period of less than seven days, or that represent funds for which the depository institution does not reserve the right to require at least seven days' written notice of an intended withdrawal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: demand deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account that provides a record of money placed with a depository institution for safekeeping and management
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: charge for services performed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: accounting record summarizing changes in position as transactions are posted during an accounting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general ledger

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event that has a monetary impact and is documented in the records associated with an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: individual transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier for a bank account that is an expanded version of the basic bank account number (BBAN), intended for use internationally
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international bank account identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account that provides a record of deposits of funds and/or securities held at a financial institution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account associated with a product or service that requires the account holder to provide funds for management by the account provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment or deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account recorded in a general ledger
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ledger account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate officer that has overarching responsibility for the relationship with a specific borrower or account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lending officer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account associated with a service in which the account holder receives funds from the account provider under certain terms and conditions for repayment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan or credit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any deposit account that is not explicitly considered a transaction account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-transaction deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date on which something was created
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date by which payment of the current outstanding balance, part thereof, or a minimum amount due must be made to the creditor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment due date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date that determines in which posting period a document or journal entry is added to an account record
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: posting date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: responsible party who manages a client's account and oversees their relationship with the service provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship manager

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time deposit account that allows deposits evidenced by a negotiable or nonnegotiable instrument, or a deposit in book entry form evidenced by a receipt or similar acknowledgement issued by the bank, that provides, on its face, that the amount of such deposit is payable to the bearer, to any specified person, or to the order of a specified person, as follows: (1) on a certain date not less than seven days after the date of deposit, (2) at the expiration of a specified period not less than seven days after the date of the deposit, or (3) upon written notice to the bank which is to be given not less than seven days before the date of withdrawal.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: time certificate of deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: deposit account that the depositor does not have a right, and is not permitted, to make withdrawals from within six days after the date of deposit unless the deposit is subject to an early withdrawal penalty of at least seven days' simple interest on amounts withdrawn within the first six days after deposit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: time deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time deposit account that allows deposits (other than time certificates of deposit) for which there is in force a written contract with the depositor that neither the whole nor any part of such deposit may be withdrawn prior to (1) the date of maturity, which shall be not less than seven days after the date of the deposit, or (2) the expiration of a specified period of written notice of not less than seven days
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: time deposit open account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: high-level classifier for an individual transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction category

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date on which a specific transaction was initiated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: deposit account from which the depositor / account holder is permitted to make transfers or withdrawals by negotiable / transferable instruments, payment orders of withdrawal, telephone transfers, and so forth, and that may be accessible via an electronic device such as an automated teller machine (ATM), remote service unit (RSU), mobile device, and by debit card
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction deposit account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier for an individual transaction associated with an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: record of transactions associated with an account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction record

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier for record of transactions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction record identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: second-level classifier for a transaction, e.g., direct deposit, check, cash advance, withdrawal, payment, purchase, and so forth
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction subcategory

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: agreement that designates a party as a registered agent to represent and act on behalf of another party in some, typically legal, financial, or medical capacity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agency agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registered agent (person or organization) designated by a business entity, such as a corporation, to receive legal correspondence on behalf of the business entity in the jurisdiction in which the agent's address is located
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agent for service of process

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection of goods, services, or other things (e.g., financial contracts) that can be purchased and sold in some marketplace
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a basket
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any party that acts as an intermediary between a buyer and a seller, usually charging a commission
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: broker

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any party in the business of buying and selling securities, operating as both a broker and a dealer, depending on the transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: broker-dealer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: publication including a list of products available for sale with their descriptions and possibly prices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: catalog

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lifecycle of an agreement, including, but not limited to a credit agreement, financial instrument, or other formal contract, from initial stages through retirement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract lifecycle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of an agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract lifecycle event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: actual occurrence of an event during a specific stage of a specific contract lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract lifecycle event occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of the lifecycle of a specific contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract lifecycle occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: phase in the lifecycle of an agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract lifecycle stage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization, from start to finish of a phase in an occurrence of a specific contract lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract lifecycle stage occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any party that purchases goods or services for resale and acts on their own behalf in a transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dealer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the extent to which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exposure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the extent to which an individual or organization is open to risk of suffering a loss in a transaction, or with respect to some investment or set of investments, e.g., some holding; the amount one stands to lose in that transaction or investment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial exposure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any financial service in which a third party (the intermediary) matches lenders and investors with entrepreneurs and other borrowers in need of capital
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial intermediation service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: catalog of financial products and/or services available for sale with their description and other product details
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial product catalog

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: service provided to consumers and businesses by financial institutions such as banks, insurance companies, brokerage firms, consumer finance companies, and investment companies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: functional entity either licensed to provide financial services to consumers and/or businesses or established by law to provide financial services, such as a central bank
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial service provider

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: real or personal property (assets), including but not limited to financial assets, to which one holds title and of which one has possession
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: holding

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any party that has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any individual who is licensed to perform a legally binding function, and who has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: licensed agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that receives an offer from something from someone (i.e., an offerer) based on the terms of the offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: offeree

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expression of interest in providing something to someone that is contingent upon acceptance, forbearance, or some other consideration, as might be desired by an offeree(s)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that proposes to make something available to someone (i.e., an offeree) based on the terms of the offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: offeror

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an investor's stake, i.e., a holding, in a particular asset (such as an individual security)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: position

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lifecycle specific to a product or product family
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product lifecycle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of a product lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product lifecycle event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: actual occurrence of an event that happens during a specific stage of a specific product lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product lifecycle event occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of the lifecycle of a specific product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product lifecycle occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: phase in a product lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product lifecycle stage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of a specific stage in the lifecycle of a given product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product lifecycle stage occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal agent designated by some party to represent them and act on their behalf under a formal agency agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registered agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commodity under the jurisdiction of the regulatory agency, such as the Commodities Futures Trading Commission (CFTF) in the United States, which includes any commodity traded in an organized contracts market
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulated commodity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract terms that define the commitment to and mechanism for settling one or more sides of a transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: settlement terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any service provider that is licensed to perform a legally binding function and has been legally empowered to act on behalf of another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: third-party agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation that realizes an agreement between parties participating in a voluntary action of buying and selling goods and services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters identifying a trade within some context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lifecycle that defines the evolution of a trade, from initiation through settlement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade lifecycle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of the lifecycle of a trade
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade lifecycle event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of an event that happens during a specific stage of a specific trade lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade lifecycle event occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of the lifecycle for a specific trade
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade lifecycle occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: phase in the lifecycle of a trade
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade lifecycle stage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of a phase in the lifecycle of a specific trade
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trade lifecycle stage occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that engages in the transfer of financial assets in any financial market on behalf of a client or the financial services provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trader

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: approach used for buying and selling in the securities markets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trading strategy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters identifying a financial transaction uniquely whenever useful and agreed by the parties or community involved in the transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unique transaction identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket whose constituents have some relative importance with respect to one another
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a basket whose relative importance with respect to other basket constituents is known
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted basket constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: capital contributed in excess of the par value (stated value) of the ownership interest issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital surplus

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of potential cash flow that excludes the effects of capital structure, taxes and non-cash expenses
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: non-physical, tangible asset whose value is derived from a contractual claim, such as bank deposits, bonds, stocks, rights, certificates, and bank balances
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: revenue received during a period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: owners' share in a business plus operating profit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: owners' equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assets received from investors in exchange for an ownership interest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: paid-in capital

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tangible asset that has a material form, such as property, equipment, and inventory
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: net profits kept to accumulate in a business after dividends are paid
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retained earnings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: equity that is manifested in the form of shares in an entity, fund or structured product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: shareholders' equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: amount of readily available cash in banknotes and coins
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: amount of money

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: monetary price determined by a formula
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calculated price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: medium of exchange value, defined by reference to the geographical location of the monetary authorities responsible for it
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: selected group of currencies, in which the weighted average is used as a measure of the value or the amount of an obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters representing some currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: artificial currency used as calculation basis for another currency(s) and accounting purposes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: funds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters that can be used to uniquely identify funds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: funds identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: amount charged, expressed as a percentage of principal, in exchange for the use of assets
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure that is an amount of money specified in monetary units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: monetary amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price that that is expressed as a monetary amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: monetary price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of some amount of money expressed as a percentage of some other amount, some notional amount or some concrete money amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: percentage monetary amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: metal that is considered to be rare and/or have a high economic value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: precious metal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying the precious metal in some context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: precious metal identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: amount of money, goods, or services requested, expected, required, or given in exchange for something else
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nominal monetary unit of measure used to represent the real value (or cost) of any economic item; i.e. goods, services, assets, liabilities, income, expenses
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit of account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters that can be used to uniquely identify a nominal monetary unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit of account identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: monetary price expressed in relation to a well-known measurable unit by which the goods or services are allocated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system that reduces or eliminates the need for human involvement in order to complete a task
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: automated system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person who has attained the age of majority as defined in some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: adult

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: age at which someone acquires the rights and responsibilities of an adult in some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: age of majority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an original document certifying the circumstances of the birth, or a certified copy of or representation of the ensuing registration of that birth
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: birth certificate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating identifiers to birth certificates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: birth certificate identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier associated with a vital record documenting the birth of a child
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: birth certificate identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: explicit date, i.e., the day, month and year, on which an individual was born
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: date of birth

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: explicit date, i.e., the day, month and year, on which an individual died
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: date of death

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: original document certifying the circumstances of the death (such as how and when it occurred), or a certified copy of or representation of the ensuing registration of that death
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: death certificate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating identifiers to death certificates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: death certificate identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier associated with a vital record documenting the death of an individual
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: death certificate identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an official document which states that a person may operate a motorized vehicle, such as a motorcycle, car, truck or a bus, on a public roadway or provides official identifying information for a non-driver
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: driver's license

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating identifiers to driver's, operating, or non-driver identification documents
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: driver's license identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier associated with a drivers' or operating license for operating a motor vehicle or non-driver identification card
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: driver's license identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a minor who is allowed to conduct a business or any other occupation on his or her own behalf or for their own account outside the control of a parent or guardian
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: emancipated minor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any legal document which may be used to verify aspects of a person's identity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: identity document

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an adult who is legally identified as not having legal capacity, typically as a result of some inherent physical or mental incapacity or as a result of having contracted some illness which temporarily deprives them of such capacity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: incapacitated adult

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: age at which someone acquires the capacity to do something that they were prohibited from doing before under the law in some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal age

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: age at which someone acquires the capacity to work legally in some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal working age

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person whose age is greater than the minimum legal working age specified in a jurisdiction in which they work
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal working age person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person who has attained the age of majority as defined in some jurisdiction and who is allowed to conduct a business or any other occupation on his or her own behalf or for their own account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legally capable adult

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a person under a certain age, usually the age of majority in a given jurisdiction, which legally demarcates childhood from adulthood
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: minor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: number or text which appears on an identity document issued by a country or jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national identification number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating identifiers to national identification numbers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national identification number scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal identity document, issued by a national government, which certifies the identity and nationality of its holder for the purpose of international travel
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: passport

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: national identification number associated with a passport
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: passport number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating identifiers to passports
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: passport number identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: individual human being, with consciousness of self
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: designation by which someone is known in some context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: person name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical location, including country, region, and municipality where an individual was born
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: place of birth

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: negotiated understanding between two or more parties, reflecting the offer and acceptance of commitments on the part of either party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that receives some benefit or advantage or profits from something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: beneficiary

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: promise made by some party to act or refrain from acting in some manner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commitment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment made by some party without direct involvement from the potential beneficiaries of that commitment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commitment at large

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment made by some party unilaterally to another specific party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: individual unilateral commitment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: agreement between two or more specific named parties whereby the rights and obligations embodied in the agreement cannot be transferred to another party without prior agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mutual agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment between two or more parties
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mutual commitment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party to whom some commitment or obligation is owed, either legally or per the terms of an agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: obligee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is bound legally or by agreement to repay a debt, make a payment, do something, or refrain from doing something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: obligor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment made by one party without reference any other the party to which the commitment is made
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unilateral commitment
