https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract in which contract holder (assignor) may transfer some or all of their rights and obligations to another party (assignee)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: assignable contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier of events representing a violation of an express, or implied, condition of a contract to do or not to do something, without a legitimate excuse
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: breach of contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier of events representing breaking a promise specified in a contract to do or not to do something, without a legitimate excuse
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: breach of covenant

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written contract related to another contract designed to provide clarity and additional protection for all parties involved, that is separate from the primary contract and that can be independently enforced
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collateral agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: stipulation that specifies conditions that must be met before some aspect of a contract takes effect
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: condition precedent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: voluntary, deliberate agreement between competent parties to which the parties agree to be legally bound, and for which the parties provide valuable consideration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal document that records the formal terms and conditions of some contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract document

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for an event (milestone), or set of events related to the status or level of completion of a designated activity, task, or segment of work required for contract fulfillment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract milestone

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legally competent party that has entered into a binding agreement, accepting and conceding obligations, responsibilities, and benefits as specified
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that originates a contract and is identified as the first party to that contract, in the event that the contract distinguishes any party as such
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract principal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is indirectly involved in, but not a counterparty to, an agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contract third party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provision specifying something that the contracting parties agree to
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual commitment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual element that specifies the meaning of a term in a legal document, whose definition is substitutable for the term whenever it occurs in the body of that document
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual definition

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: element, such as an arrangement, provision, requirement, rule, specification, and standard that forms an integral part of an agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual element

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party to a contract with whom one negotiates on a given agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: counterparty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual provision that outlines the requirements and responsibilities of one or both parties to reveal certain information to each other
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: disclosure provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract terms that specify the conditions under which a contract can be extended
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: extension provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract between named parties that outlines the terms and conditions designed to apply to a number of accounts, transactions, or other activities between the parties, and that consolidates and provides overarching terms for separate but related agreements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: master agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event related to the status or level of completion of a designated activity, task, or segment of work required for contract fulfillment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: milestone event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule of milestone events, observations, or other occurrences and the associated dates and/or times when they will be done
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: milestone schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract between named parties whose individual rights and obligations are not transferable to another party without prior written permission
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mutual contractual agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual element that is not legally binding on any party to the agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-binding term

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract that may be replaced by another contract, and in that event, extinguishes the rights and obligations in effect under the original contract with those in the new agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: novateable contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual element that is a statement made by a party to the contract, before or at the time of making the contract, in regard to some fact, circumstance, or state of affairs pertinent to the contract, which the counterparty(ies) rely on, or is influential in bringing about the contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: representation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nonbinding agreement setting forth the basic terms and conditions under which a proposed business deal may be made
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: term sheet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual element that specifies the circumstances under which the parties can dissolve their legal relationship and discontinue the fulfillment of their obligations under the contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: termination provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract in which the rights and obligations of one party may be transferred to another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transferable contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract in which one party makes an express promise without securing a reciprocal agreement from the other party(ies)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unilateral contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract provision specifying how funds obtained through financing, such as through a credit agreement, offering, warrant, or other instrument are intended to be used
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: use of proceeds provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract that exists as a result of some verbal exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: verbal contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual element that is a statement of fact
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: warranty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal contract that is written and signed by the parties thereto
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: written contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structure or means of organizing information such as a blueprint, schema, numbering system, organization structure, measurement system, plan, taxonomy, or language for organizing information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written estimate of the market value of something as of some point in time, typically provided by a qualified appraiser
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: appraisal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: estimated value of some asset as of a given point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: appraised value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that evaluates or estimates the nature, quality, ability, or value of someone or something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: appraiser

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: activity involving the evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, ability, or value of someone or something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: assessment activity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event involving the evaluation or estimation of the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: assessment event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: report that includes an opinion, judgement, appraisal, or view about something and typically the methodology and raw inputs used to arrive at that opinion
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: assessment report

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: judgement, appraisal, or view about something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: opinion

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: method used to determine the present or expected worth of an asset
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: valuation method

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assessment event to estimate the value of something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: value assessment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating classifiers to organizations by industry sector
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: industry sector classification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standardized classification or delineation for an organization, or possibly for a security representing an interest in a given organization, per some scheme for such delineation, by industry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: industry sector classifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: record of financial information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial record

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indirect shortcut derived from and pointing into, a greater volume of values, data, information or knowledge
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for indexing values, data, information, or knowledge
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: indexing scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that uniquely identifies something for a given time period, and that may be reused to identify something else at a different point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reassignable identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: arrangement that compares the cyclical nature of families, organizations, processes, products, marketing, and order management, portfolio management or other systems with the cradle to grave life stages (birth, growth, maturity, decay, and death) of living organisms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: kind of event that occurs during one or more stages of a lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of an event in a stage of a lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle event occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of a lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: phase in a lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle stage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: realization of a phase in a given lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle stage occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier indicating the position or state of something at a particular point in its life-cycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lifecycle status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rating score that is represented as a qualitative code with respect to some rating scale
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: qualitative rating score

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rating score that is a simple numeric value on some scale, such as a credit rating for an individual
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quantitative rating score

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standing of something at a particular time, indicated by at least one scores with respect to some scale, based on an assessment by some party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rating issuer that is also a rating scale publisher, frequently but not always an independent rating service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assessment activity resulting in a grade or score and potentially a report describing the score and the process used to determine that score
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating assessment activity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: individual assessment resulting in a grade or score and potentially a report describing the score
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating assessment event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is responsible for issuing ratings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person, organization or group that analyzes some aspect of something and develops a rating
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: report describing a set of ratings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating report

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for assigning a value to something according to some scale with respect to quality, a standard, or ranking
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating scale

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party responsible for managing one or more rating schemes and potentially publishing ratings based on those schemes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating scale publisher

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grade, classification, or ranking of for something in accordance with some rating scale
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rating score

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: document that provides a structured description of something, prepared on ad hoc, periodic, recurring, regular, or as required basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: report

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party providing a report, typically in response to some contractual, legal, regulatory or other business requirement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reporting party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event in which some party asks another party for something at some point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: request

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: activity in which some party asks another party for something or to do something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: request activity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that asks for something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: requester

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party presenting something, such as a regulatory report
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: submitter

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention that specifies what happens when a date falls on a day that is a weekend or a holiday in one or more business centers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day adjustment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention that enumerates the possible ways to handle a date that falls on a weekend or holiday
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: recurrence interval that is defined per a specific convention that determines how recurring days should be handled
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business recurrence interval

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention that specifies how recurring days should be handled, such as the end of the month, a particular day of the month, a day of the week, or more specifically, a t-bill auction date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business recurrence interval convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: widely accepted or established way of doing 'something' within some community of practice
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specific, recurring day of the month
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: day of month

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specific, recurring day of the week
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: day of the week

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the last day of a calendar month, irrespective of the length of the calendar month
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: end of the month

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule consisting of some number of individual events that are not necessarily recurring
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ad hoc schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry, including a date or date and time, among multiple non-regularly-recurring entries in a schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ad hoc schedule entry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: length of time that something or someone has been alive or existed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: age

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: fixed reference point within a series or timeline
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: anchor date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule and communications tool used to manage meetings, plan events, and coordinate activities within and/or across organizations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business calendar

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date that is or will be determined based on some formula
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calculated date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: explicit period from the start to the end of a specific interval or range within which a computational process or operation occurs
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calculation period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: explicit number of days from the adjusted effective or start date to the adjusted termination or end date calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calculation period length

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time interval that occurs within a system that fixes the beginning and length of a segment of the year with respect to that system
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calendar period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: recurrence interval that is defined as the nth day of some calendar period (such as a calendar month), and a time direction (forward from the beginning of the month, or backwards from the end)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calendar-specified interval

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: element of a collection that is associated with a date and time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dated collection constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection whose elements are required to have a date and time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dated structured collection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: recurrence interval defined via an explicit duration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: explicit recurrence interval

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time interval that is consistent between elements of a regular schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: recurrence interval

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule whose time intervals recur regularly
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regular schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is some duration before or after another date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relative date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection of events, observations, or other occurrences and the associated dates and/or times when they will be done
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date period before the start of the recurring part of a schedule or after the end of the recurring part, which may be associated with a specific occurrence kind
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: schedule stub

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is defined by a rule that is captured as a string by the 'hasDateSpecification' property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: specified date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: enumeration that indicates whether a calendar-specified date is figured from the start or the end of a calendar period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: time direction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: actual execution of some computation, computational process, or operation that was scheduled or triggered by something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calculation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: kind of event that is either scheduled or triggered by something, such as a related financial event, that causes a calculation to be performed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calculation event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: happening of an OccurrenceKind, i.e., an event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: occurrence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is defined with respect to the occurrence of some occurrence kind
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: occurrence-based date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier that specifies the general nature of an occurrence (event)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: occurrence kind

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: objective that reflects the strategic goals and direction of a business within a time frame and available resources
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business objective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: strategy for achieving a specific business goal, objective, solution or outcome
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business strategy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: strategy for making a product or service available, or for distributing funds, such as in the form of a dividend or coupon
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: distribution strategy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: objective that reflects the strategic financial goals and direction of a party within a time frame and available resources
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial objective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: desired result that a party envisions, plans, and to which it commits, in order to achieve a desired state
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: goal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial objective used by an investor to determine whether or not a given potential investment is appropriate for themselves or on behalf of another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment objective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term, quantitative, measurable result that a party seeks to attain in order to achieve its long-term goals
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: objective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state of affairs and coordinated set of activities designed to obtain benefits not available from managing them individually
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: program

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a specific program within the context in which that program is administered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: program identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contextual designation for a program within the context in which that program is administered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: program name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state of affairs and unique and temporary organization, designed to deliver a tangible output
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: project

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a specific project within the context in which that project or an overarching program is administered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: project identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contextual designation for a project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: project name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: strategy for selling something, including allocating resources to the sales process, reducing costs, and optimizing revenues
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sales strategy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: plan or method for achieving a specific goal, objective, solution or outcome
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: strategy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: power of a court to adjudicate cases, issue orders, and interpret and apply the law with respect to some specific geographic area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: law enacted by a legislature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statute law

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: demand or assertion made by one party on another, based on facts that, taken together, give rise to a legally enforceable right or judicial action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: claim

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: obligation that depends on a future event or the performance of an action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contingent obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: right that depends on a future event or the performance of an action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contingent right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the capacity to enter into legally binding contracts
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual capability

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: obligation or duty that is specified in and imposed by a contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual right that may be exercised at some point in the future, such as an option to extend a contract, or other available but not obligatory rights as defined in the contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual option

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: power, privilege, demand, or claim possessed by some party that is conferred by contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: institutionalized and legal power inherent in a particular job, function, or position that is meant to enable its holder to successfully carry out his or her responsibilities, where such power has been delegated through some formal means
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delegated legal authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: some obligation which exists and is imposed on some individual
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: duty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the capability to carry out certain actions or to have certain rights together with the resources to do so
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal capacity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: something which is conferred by way of law or contract, such as a right
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal construct

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an obligation or duty that is enforceable by a court
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: power, privilege, demand, or claim possessed by some party by virtue of law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the ability to be sued at law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: liability capacity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grant of permission needed to do something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: license

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an identifier associated with a license
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: license identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a party to whom a license has been granted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: licensee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a party who grants a license
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: licensor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the legal capacity to pursue a litigation action in law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: litigation capacity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system of principles, rules and guidelines, adopted by an organization to guide decision making with respect to particular situations and implemented via procedures or protocols to achieve stated goals
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a rule used to carry out a law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: policy specifying principles, rules and/or guidelines regarding some aspect of reporting
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reporting policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entitlement (not) to perform certain actions, or (not) to be in certain states; or entitlement that others (not) perform certain actions or (not) be in certain states
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the capacity of some natural person to sign agreements on the part of some organization or legal person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: signatory capacity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: set of basic principles by which an organization is governed, especially in relation to the rights of the people it governs
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: constitution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person or body of persons having judicial authority to hear and resolve disputes on the basis of statutes or the common law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: court of law

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rule recognized by some community as regulating the behavior of its members and that it may enforce through the imposition of penalties
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: law

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person in the service of another under any contract of hire, express or implied, oral or written, where the employer has the right to control and direct that person in the material details of how the work is to be performed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that provides compensation, including wages or a salary and potentially other benefits, in exchange for work performed by one or more people, and that has the right to control and direct the employee in the material details of how the work is to be performed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation representing the state of being employed, i.e., the relationship that holds between an employer and employee for some period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: organization that is recognized in some legal jurisdiction, with associated rights and responsibilities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: formal organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection of agents (people, organizations, software agents, etc.) that are considered as a unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: group

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: organization that is not formally constituted in some way
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: informal organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of a group or organization that has members that are people or other organizations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: member-bearing organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation, corresponding to an n-ary relation, in which some group or organization has at least one member (person or organization) for some period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: membership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection of one or more people, or groups of people formed together into a community or other social, commercial or political structure to act, or that is designated to act, towards some purpose, such as to meet a need or pursue collective goals on a continuing basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identification scheme dedicated to the unique identification of organizations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier assigned to an organization within an organization identification scheme, and unique within that scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party (person or organization) that has a membership role with respect to some organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization member

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: designation by which some organization is known in some context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier allocated to a particular organizational sub-unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization part identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any department, service, and other entity within a larger organization that only has full recognition within the context of that organization, but requires identification for some purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organizational sub-unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation in which some party has the power to direct or strongly influence the direction of the management and policies related to something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: control

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: something over which some party exercises some form of control with respect to some situation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlled thing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: actor that exercises some form of control in the context of some situation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlling party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: control that exists informally and is accepted, although not formally recognized
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: de facto control

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: control that exists as a matter of law, i.e., legitimate, legal control of something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: de jure control

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: something of monetary value that is owned or provides benefit to some party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifiable, non-monetary asset that lacks physical substance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: intangible asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is legally recognized as having the right to possess, the privilege to use, and ability to transfer any rights or privileges associated with something, as permitted by law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: owner

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation in which some party holds the legal title to something (explicitly or implicitly) and has the right to transfer that title and/or possession
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ownership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset that is a physical, measurable resource, i.e., one that takes a physical form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tangible asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation in which some party owns and controls something
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ownership control situation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating identifiers to roles that parties play
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: party role identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters, capable of uniquely identifying a party based on a specific role that they play in some context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: party role identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identification scheme used to identify taxpayers in some jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tax identification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier assigned to a taxpayer that enables compulsory financial charges and other levies to be imposed on the taxpayer by a governmental organization in order to fund government spending and various public expenditures
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tax identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: index to a location to which communications may be delivered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: aspect of an address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: address component

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system for allocating addresses to objects
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: addressing scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical address that identifies a location on a street to which communications may be delivered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: conventional street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code element that gives directional information for postal delivery
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: geographic directional symbol

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical address where communications can be addressed, papers served or representatives located for any kind of organization or person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier for a physical address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical address identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme for specifying physical addresses according to a country specific standard
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical addressing scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical area uniquely identified by some postal code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: post code area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: post office box associated with an address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: post office box

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical address used to deliver communications to a designated container at a local post office or the local equivalent for the jurisdiction, where mail is held until the recipient collects it, rather than to a given house, building, or other location
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: post office box address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: designator used, together with an identifier, for a post office box
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: post office box designator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters used to assist in the sorting of mail
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: postcode

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: geographic directional symbol that follows the street name and street suffix in a street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: postdirectional symbol

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: geographic directional symbol that occurs after the primary street number but before the street name in a street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: predirectional symbol

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address component that identifies a location with respect to a given street
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: primary address number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: geographic region or subdivision identifier used internally by a country or other region
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: region-specific identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address component that identifies an individual unit within a larger structure, such as an apartment, office, hangar, slip, mailbox, and so forth, at a given street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: secondary unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for a smaller structure or component within a larger facility, such as an apartment, office, mail stop, or other similar designation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: secondary unit designator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: index to the specific unit within a secondary unit, such as a building or apartment, at a particular street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: secondary unit indicator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: index to a location that consists of a primary address number, predirectional, street name, suffix, postdirectional, and an optional secondary unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier for a street in some context (e.g., city, municipality, geographic region)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: street name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for a street or other delivery location, such as a dwelling located along a waterway
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: street suffix

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: name for a building, house, office complex, shopping center, or other structure or group of structures
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: structure name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address component that provides additional information that is important to ensuring proper delivery of communications
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplemental address component

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for supplemental address information, such as a highway contract route, rural route, building complex, shopping center, condominium complex, mail box, or other similar designation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplemental address designator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address component that includes a specific route, box, apartment, condominium or other indicator or unit associated with a specific address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplemental address unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address identifying a virtual, i.e. non-physical, location
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: virtual address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ability to perform a particular type of work that may involve people with particular skills and knowledge, intellectual property, defined practices, operating facilities, tools and equipment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capability

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: something established to serve a particular purpose, make some course of action or operation easier, or provide some capability or service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: place, setting, or context in which something, such as a facility, is situated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: site

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: site where something happens, described in the context of the event or activity that occurs there
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: venue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipality where business is conducted, especially one that is considered a financial center
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business center

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: political and administrative division of a country, state or province, providing certain local governmental services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: county

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: geopolitical entity that is or includes the municipality or capital city that acts as the seat of the federal government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: federal capital area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: self-governing geopolitical unit which forms part of a wider geopolitical unit that is recognized as a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: federal state

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: urban administrative division having corporate status and usually powers of self-government or jurisdiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipality

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: location in physical space
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical location

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: community in which people live or have lived, without being specific as to size, population or importance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: populated place

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address that has all the address elements necessary to allow an exact match with the current Postal Service ZIP+4 and City State files to obtain the finest level of ZIP+4 and delivery point codes for the delivery address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: complete address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery address code set

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specific set of digits between 00 and 99 assigned to a delivery point
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery point code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery point code set

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, 'DPO' as the literal value for the city, and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Department of State address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a Department of State address that includes 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Department of State unit component

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address that uses the words 'GENERAL DELIVERY', uppercase preferred, spelled out (no abbreviation), in place of a street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general delivery address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: highway contract route associated with an address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: highway contract route

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'HC', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: highway contract address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical address that explicitly includes a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mailbox, other than a U.S. Post Office box, associated with an address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mailbox

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses an abbreviation for the unit or command such as 'CMR', 'PSC', or 'UNIT', or 'HC', followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, either 'APO' or 'FPO' as the literal value for the city and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: overseas military address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address provided by a commercial mail receiving company that includes a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'PMB' or the pound "#" symbol followed by the mailbox number; alternatively, 'PMB' or '#" and the mailbox number can be appended to the street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private mail box address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address for a delivery point in Puerto Rico that may include a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'URB' followed by the name of the urbanization area that is appropriate for that address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Puerto Rico address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mail route outside the city or township limits in a rural area associated with an address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: highway contract route address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'RR', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rural route address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address that is fully spelled out, abbreviated by using the Postal Service standard abbreviations or as given in the current Postal Service ZIP+4 file
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standardized address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: combined with the ZIP + 4 code, the delivery point code provides a unique identifier for every deliverable address served by the USPS
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: U.S. Postal Service address identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an area, sector, or development within a larger geographic area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: urbanization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: five-digit code code assigned to a delivery address indicating the state and post office or postal zone
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Zip Code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-digit number consisting of five digits, a hyphen, and four digits, which the USPS describes by its trademark ZIP+4
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ZIP+4 Code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system used in the U.S. to facilitate the delivery of mail, consisting of a five- or nine-digit code Zone Improvement Plan (ZIP) printed directly after the address, the first five digits (initial code) indicating the state and post office or postal zone, the last four (expanded code) the box section or number, portion of a rural route, building, or other specific delivery location
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: zip code scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset that is a movable item or possession not fixed to land
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: personal property

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event that involves analyzing one or more aspects of a real property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: property inspection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: report covering the findings of a property inspection
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: property inspection report

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: real property, interests in mortgages on real property (including interests in mortgages on leaseholds of land or improvements thereon), and shares in qualified real estate investment trusts
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real estate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical asset defined as land together with any structures that are permanently attached to that land, such as houses, trees, fences and improvements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real property

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value assessment that estimates the amount of money some real property is worth
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real property appraisal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier given to identify a specific real property in some jurisidiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real property identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier given to identify a tract in some jurisidiction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tract identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: geographic region that is a specific area within a larger region on the surface of the earth
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tract of land

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: virtual address that defines an electronic messaging endpoint to which email messages can be delivered, typically via an Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) based communications system
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: electronic mail address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a virtual location that may be identified by a network address (an identifier for a node or interface)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: network location

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an abstract place; one of many commonly understood concepts such as domestic, Eurozone etc.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: notional place

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: virtual address that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices or services for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: telephone number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: place that is not located in any single physical location; a network location without geographic boundaries
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: virtual location

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a party to whom a debt should be paid, or to whose order a bill of exchange, note, or check is made payable, or who receives or will receive a payment from a payer in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a party who pays a bill or fees, or who makes payments to a payee in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation, such as to satisfy a claim or debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an event that involves delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legally enforceable duty to pay a sum of money according to the terms stated in a contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule for delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that purchases something in exchange for money or other consideration under a contract of sale
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: buyer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that purchases professional services from, or has a formal relationship to purchase services from another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: client

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a client within the context of some organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: client identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: material resource used in commerce that is interchangeable with other commodities of the same type
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commodity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that utilizes economic goods or services, typically for personal, family, or household purposes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product that takes the form of an agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual product that is finalized through specification of values for parameters defined in a template
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual template product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product that is made to order, commissioned based on a customer's specifications
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: custom product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that receives or consumes products (goods or services) and has the ability to choose between different products and suppliers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: customer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a customer within the context of some organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: customer identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical, produced item over which ownership rights can be established, whose ownership can be passed from one party to another by engaging in transactions, and that is not money or real estate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: good

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commodity that can be bought or sold in some marketplace
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: negotiable commodity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product that is readily available from merchandise in stock, or can be quickly and easily configured to order, not specially designed or custom-made
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: off-the-shelf product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grower, maker, fabricator, or manufacturer of some product or other good
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: producer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commercially distributed good that is (1) tangible property, (2) the output or result of a fabrication, manufacturing, or production process, or (3) something that passes through a distribution channel before being consumed or used.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a product in some context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange of goods or services for money
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sale

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that makes, offers or contracts to make a sale to an actual or potential buyer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seller

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: intangible activity performed by some party for the benefit of another party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written contract between a client and service provider whereby the service provider supplies some service in the form of time, effort, and/or expertise in exchange for compensation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: service agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that provides and typically provisions professional services, such as consulting, financial, legal, real estate, education, communications, storage, or processing services, to other parties, typically defined in a service agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: service provider

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that provides goods or services that some party wants or needs, especially over a long period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written communication from a seller or service provider reciting the relevant details of a transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction confirmation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any sale, assignment, lease, license, loan, advance, contribution, or other transfer of any interest in or right to use any property (tangible or intangible) or money, however that transaction is effected, and regardless of whether the terms of the transaction are formally documented
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: something that another concept stands for, exemplifies, symbolizes, or otherwise mentions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: referent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Any transaction which defines a supply of some negotiable item in return for some Consideration. The Market Transaction has a Principal and a Counterparty, i.e. it is not symmetrical.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An economic agreement forming part of a transaction, which has contractual standing as evidenced by a contract between the two parties to the Agreement.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual economic agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An economic transaction which has some contractual basis.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: That which is party to a transaction which has contractual standing.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual transaction party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A transaction covered by some Master Agreement.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: covered transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some Commitment which forms part of the subject of some Transaction, being an undertaking by one or other of the parties to the transaction, extended to the other party to that same transaction.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic commitment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A contract relating to and governing an economic transaction between two parties.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Terms underlying the contract for a transaction.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic contract commitment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Anything that can bought sold or exchanged.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic resource

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some exchange of some items of economic value between two parties (economic agents).
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some imbalance, at a given point in time, between the respective rights and obligations of two parties with respect to one another.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: r e a claim

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Occurrence in time that partners to a business transaction wish to monitor or control.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction business event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The event component of a transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A transaction side as seen from the perspective of one of the parties to the transaction.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction event aspect

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some entity which takes part in some transaction by receiving and/or parting with some item of economic value or some payment or both.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A contractually defined and established commitment to deliver some goods, perform some service or make some payment in cash or in kind.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction undertaking

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some undertaking to act.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: undertaking

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Something which occurs at a point in time, at which a party makes some commitment to some other party.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: undertaking event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A Transaction in which some negotiable security is provided in exchange for some Consideration.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial securities secondary market transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The contract (written or implied) which governs the transaction of securities in the secondary Market.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities transaction contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Trading in securities ahead of them being traded.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: when issued transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standard deviation for some measure over a specific reference period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: annualized standard deviation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sum of a collection of numbers divided by the number of numbers in the collection
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: arithmetic mean

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: average of the absolute deviations from a central point
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average absolute deviation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: quantity by which amounts differ; the remainder left after subtraction of one value from another
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: difference

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: degree of scatter or variability shown by observations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dispersion

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: population for which it is possible to count its units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finite population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rule expressed in letters and symbols that consists of at least one expression
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: formula

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mean that indicates the central tendency or typical value of a set of numbers by using the product of their values (as opposed to the arithmetic mean which uses their sum)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: geometric mean

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measurable target that indicates how an individual or business is performing in terms of meeting its goals
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: key performance indicator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: most common measure of central tendency; the average of a set of numbers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mean

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value of the variate dividing the total frequency of a data sample, population, or probability distribution, into two halves
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: median

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: median of the absolute deviations of observations from the average which may be the arithmetic mean, the median or the mode
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: median absolute deviation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: numeric value of some aggregate relative to the value of that aggregate as of some date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: numeric index value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure that is constrained by features, quantity kinds or units that refine how it is calculated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: qualified measure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the extent to which the estimate of a characteristic from different possible samples of the same size and the same design differ from one another
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sampling variance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualified measure that is constrained by filters on the statistical population to which it applies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scoped measure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: square root of variance that measures the spread or dispersion around the mean of a data set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standard deviation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical location that is defined per some program for designating geographic regions for the purposes of tabulating and presenting statistical data
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier for a physical location that is defined per a nationally consistent program for designating geographic regions for the purposes of tabulating and presenting statistical data
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical area identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: summary (means, mode, total, index, etc.) of the individual quantitative variable values for the statistical units in a specific group (study domain)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical measure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe filtered by time and region
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: program that presents a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation involving one or more studies or surveys
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical program

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection representing the total membership, or 'universe', of people, resources, products, services, events, or entities of interest for some question, experiment, survey or statistical program
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical universe

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of spread, calculated as the average squared deviation of each number from the mean of a data set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expression or function that determines the relative importance or influence of a given element of a set with respect to the whole
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighting function

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier used to indicate the state of an artifact with respect to its development lifecycle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: maturity level

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier used to indicate a category used to modularize something based on principles of the model driven architecture methodology (MDA), including but not limited to separation of concerns, coherence, and establishing clear logical boundaries in order to increase reusability and maintainability
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: module

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average daily wage an employee makes over the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average daily earnings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average wage an hourly or salaried worker makes in a given period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average earnings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average hourly wage an employee makes over the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average hourly earnings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average monthly wage an employee makes over the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average monthly earnings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average weekly wage an employee makes over the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average weekly earnings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of gross output to a quantity index of combined inputs
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital-labor-energy-materials multifactor productivity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of value added to a quantity index of combined labor and capital input
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital-labor multifactor productivity (MFP), based on value added

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of value added to a quantity index of capital input
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital productivity, based on value added

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that is not a member of the military (i.e., that is not on active duty)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian, non-institutional population considered to be part of the labor force during a given reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian labor force

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the rate of participation the labor force of a given economy for some specified period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian labor force participation rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal working-age person that does not live in an institution (for example, a correctional facility, long-term care hospital, or nursing home), and is not on active military duty
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian non-institutional person
