https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe consisting of people of a certain age who reside in a given region, do not live in institutions (for example, correctional facilities, long-term care hospitals, and nursing homes), and are not on active military duty
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian non-institutional population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: combination of adjacent metropolitan and micropolitan areas with economic ties measured by commuting patterns
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: combined statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the change over time in the prices of consumer goods and services that households consume
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the marginally attached population that have given a job-market related reason for not currently looking for work
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: discouraged worker population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of economic activity that is regular and comparable in the context of a statistical area (region), used for analysis of economic performance and predictions of future performance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic indicator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian labor force considered to be employed during the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are working fewer than 30 to 35 hours per week based on usual working hours
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population part-time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are working fewer than 30 to 35 hours per week due to slack work, unfavorable business conditions, inability to find full-time work, and seasonal declines in demand
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population part-time for economic reasons

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are working fewer than 30 to 35 hours per week due to illness or other health or medical limitations, childcare problems, family or personal obligations, being in school or training, retirement or Social Security limits on earnings, and having a job where full-time work is less than 35 hours
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population part-time for non-economic reasons

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are temporarily absent from work for various reasons
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population temporarily not at work

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the ratio of the employed population with respect to the overall civilian non-institutional population of a given economy for some specified period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment-population ratio

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: functional business entity that produces and/or sells goods or services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: enterprise

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe consisting of enterprises designed for the purposes of supporting surveys such as those used as the basis for employment and producer price indices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: enterprise population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an enterprise (or part of an enterprise) that operates from a single physical location
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: establishment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the total number of persons who work in or for the establishment including working proprietors, active business partners and unpaid family workers, as well as persons working outside the establishment when paid by and under the control of the establishment, for example, sales representatives, outside service engineers and repair and maintenance personnel
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: establishment employment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a subset of the enterprise population focused on establishments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: establishment population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket of goods and services whose quantity and quality are held fixed for some period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a fixed basket
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed basket constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe consisting of specific goods and/or services designed for the purposes of supporting surveys such as those used as the basis for price indices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed basket population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical area defined by a government agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government-specified statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the broadest measure of aggregate economic activity, measuring the total unduplicated market value of all final goods and services produced within a statistical area in a period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: gross domestic product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: individual or small group of persons who occupy a housing unit (such as a house or apartment) as their usual place of residence, who pool some, or all, of their income and wealth and who consume certain types of goods and services collectively, mainly housing and food
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: household

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: house, an apartment, a mobile home or trailer, a group of rooms, or a single room occupied as separate living quarters, or if vacant, intended for occupancy as separate living quarters
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: housing unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing a change in prices of goods and services for a specified period, for a given statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: inflation rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the rate of change over time in the prices of inputs of goods and services purchased by the producer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: input producer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that resides in an institution for some reason, due, for example, to hospitalization, rehabilitation, or incarceration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: institutional person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is capable, in its own right, of owning assets, incurring liabilities, and engaging in economic activities and in transactions with other parties
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: institutional unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of gross output to a quantity index of labor input
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: labor productivity, based on gross output

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of value added to a quantity index of labor input
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: labor productivity, based on value added

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the population that includes people who currently are neither working nor looking for work but indicate that they want and are available for a job and have looked for work sometime in the past 12 months
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: marginally attached population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: one or more adjacent counties or county equivalents that have at least one urban core area of at least 50,000 population, plus adjacent territory that has a high degree of social and economic integration with the core as measured by commuting ties
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: metropolitan statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: one or more adjacent counties or county equivalents that have at least one urban core area of at least 10,000 population but less than 50,000, plus adjacent territory that has a high degree of social and economic integration with the core as measured by commuting ties
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: micropolitan statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that is a member of the active duty military
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: military person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the rate of change over time in the prices of products sold as they leave the producer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: output producer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the value of the goods and services purchased by, or on the behalf of, 'persons'
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: personal consumption expenditures

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian, noninstitutional population, that is considered neither employed nor unemployed by the reporting agency during the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: population not in the labor force

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the rate of change over time in the prices of goods and services bought and sold by producers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: producer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing ratio of a volume measure of output to a volume measure of input use
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: productivity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: publisher that packages and makes analytical and statistical data available
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical information publisher

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that is the ultimate user of a good, product or service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ultimate consumer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons employed part-time for economic reasons, who want and are available for full-time work but have had to settle for a part-time schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underemployed population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the underemployed population that includes persons employed in a role that does not reflect their training and experience, excluding those that change careers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underemployed population with respect to occupation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian non-institutional population that includes persons employed part-time for economic reasons, persons that are marginally attached to the labor force, and persons that are identified as unemployed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underutilized population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian labor force that is considered to have had no employment but was available for work, except for temporary illness, and had made specific efforts to find employment sometime during a specified period, during the reporting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unemployed population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the ratio of the unemployed population with respect to the civilian labor force of a given economy for some specified period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unemployment rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing a weighted average of the input and output producer price indices
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: value-added producer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing a measure of changes over time in the prices of a fixed basket of consumer goods and services that Canadian private households consume
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian consumer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a statistical universe consisting of all private households in Canada, with the exception of soldiers on military bases, people living on First Nations reserves, institutionalized persons, and households living in the rural areas of the three northern territories
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian households consumers universe

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an economic indicator representing a measure of the change over time in the prices of a fixed-basket of domestic producer goods and services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian producer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier for a sector of the economy used for price indices focused on major commodities sold by manufacturers in Canada
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: industrial products sector

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier for a sector of the economy used for price indices focused on contractors' selling prices of new residential houses, where detailed specifications pertaining to each house remain the same between two consecutive periods
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: new housing sector

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier used for price indices related to raw materials purchased by industries in Canada for further processing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: raw materials sector

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical information publisher comprised of the government agencies and departments that publish statistical information on behalf of the U.S. Federal Government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American statistics publisher

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical program conducted on a regular basis that provides information on the buying habits of consumers, including data on their expenditures, income, and consumer unit (families and single consumers) characteristics
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer expenditure survey

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to businesses and government agencies, in order to provide detailed industry data on employment, hours, and earnings of workers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: current employment statistics

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to the general population of a given statistical area with respect to labor force, employment, unemployment, persons not in the labor force, hours of work, earnings, and other demographic and labor force characteristics
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: current population survey

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to the labor force of a given statistical area, surveyed with respect to businesses, and is, for the most part, seasonally adjusted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment situation establishment survey

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to the labor force of a given statistical area, surveyed with respect to households, and is, for the most part, seasonally adjusted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment situation household survey

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information focused on the employment characteristics of a given statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment situation survey

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a program conducted on a regular basis that provides information on purchases of various items and services by consumers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: point of purchase survey

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an economic indicator representing a measure of the change over time in the selling prices received by domestic producers for their output
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: U.S. producer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an economic indicator representing a measure of the average change over time in the prices paid by urban consumers for a market basket of consumer goods and services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: urban consumer price index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a statistical universe for consumer expenditure surveys consisting of people within a household that make joint expenditure decisions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: urban consumers universe

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: foreign exchange service involving the conversion of currency of one country or group of countries for another, typically, but not always, as a counter transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency conversion service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rate of exchange between two currencies for settlement at some future point in time, expressed as a premium on the spot rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency forward rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of exchange rate fluctuation based on a range of projected values for exchange rates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency forward rate volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicative spot buying market rate as observed by the reporting source
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot buy rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicative middle market (mean of spot buying and selling) rate as observed by the reporting source
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot mid rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rate at which one currency may be exchanged for another for immediate delivery
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicative spot selling market rate as observed by the reporting source
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot sell rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of exchange rate fluctuation based on a range of past actual values for exchange rates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection of quoted or projected exchange rates, such that volatility may be constructed for the structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange rate structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of the rate of change in the rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange rate volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service involving the exchange of one currency for another, conversion of one currency for another, and transfer of money from one country to another whereby currency conversion is required
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: foreign exchange service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: electronic funds transfer (EFT) service involving the transfer of funds across national borders, that may also involve currency conversion
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international electronic funds transfer service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange rate quoted at a specific point in time, for a given block amount of currency as quoted against another (base) currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quoted exchange rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: overall level of a given rate, calculated as the sum of some selected observed values of the rates for a particular reference rate, foreign exchange rate, lending rate, or other market rate divided by the number of samples collected over the course of a twenty-four (24) hour period for a specific date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: daily average market rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value of a given market rate of the end of the business day for a specific date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: end-of-day market rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: historical volatility measure of past trading ranges of prices of underlying securities and indexes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: historical price volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of volatility that uses actual values for pricing, rates, and other measurements calculated over some prior period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: historical volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of volatility that represents the expected fluctuations of an underlying stock or index over a specific time frame
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: implied price volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of volatility that is a forward-looking metric used to calculate probability
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: implied volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value of a rate established in the marketplace for a set of instruments or that describes the economic climate for an industry and/or political region (e.g., SOFR, Prime)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure providing the difference (or spread) between two market rates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market spread

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection of prices, such as market prices for some index or security, such that volatility or other analyses may be performed over the structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of the rate of change in pricing for a given security or market index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a monetary price quoted by some publisher on a given date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quoted price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection of rates, such as interest rates, or bond yields with different terms to maturity, such that a yield curve may be constructed for the structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: term structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of the dispersion around the average of some random variable over some period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: volatility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basic rate of interest on which the actual rate a bank charges on loans to its customers is calculated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: base rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interbank rate that is the interest rate at which participating banks are willing to borrow deposits from other banks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank bid rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interbank rate that represents the mid-point between bid and offer rates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank mid rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interbank rate that is the interest rate at which participating banks lend money
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank offered rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reference rate that is the rate of interest charged on short-term loans between banks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider/publisher responsible for specifying some benchmark interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for regularly updated interest rates that are publicly accessible, typically set by a central bank or group of financial institutions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate benchmark

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme for classifying interest rate benchmarks, such as the FpML classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate benchmark classification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reference rate that is an interest rate at which a depository institution lends funds to another depository institution (short-term), or the interest rate the central bank charges a financial institution to borrow money overnight
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: overnight rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market rate that is a rate of interest paid by or agreed among some bank or set of banks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reference interest rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interest rate benchmark that is made available by a specific market data provider for reference purposes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: specific-provider interest rate benchmark

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket of instruments, legal entities, or a combination thereof collected for the purpose of analyzing risk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket of credit risks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket of securities whose constituents are listed shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket of equities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighting function derived from the relative market capitalization (share price times the number of shares outstanding) of the companies tracked by an index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capitalization-based weighting function

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reference index that is a function of credit events that change the value of an underlying portfolio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: constituent of a basket of credit risks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit index constituent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: benchmark whose constituents are exclusively equity instruments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equity index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expression representing the perceived value of a company as determined by the stock market at a specific point in time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market capitalization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of change in the value of the contents of a basket over a given period of time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reference index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: total monthly qualifying income for all borrowers on the loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: all borrowers' monthly income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assessment report detailing information about the borrower and their credit history that may be relevant to the loan application
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: borrower assessment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: total monthly qualifying income of a potential borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: borrower monthly income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: risk assessment that focuses on determining the likelihood of a potential borrower repaying a loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit risk assessment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: report providing the methodology and supporting documentation used to verify the borrower's income
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: income verification report

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit rating that provides an opinion of the creditworthiness of a person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: individual person credit rating

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: request by a potential borrower to a potential lender to borrow money containing information used to decide whether to grant the loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan application

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written commitment to lend when specified conditions are met, such as finding suitable property, and unchanged creditworthiness
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pre-approval contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Rights on the lender to protect them against loss. furthe rNtoes: Logically, considering the two parties, they both have protecxtion mechanisms. so while the lender has protecxtion mechanisms through mortgage insurance, and the consumer has protextion mechanisms such as good faith estimates. also the agencies (see Consumer Protection Agency), an instance of which is the CFPB in the US (just set up). Lender rights are: - expressed in the Contract Consumer protection develops becaues the contract is written by the potential Lender. So the rights are introcued to rectify the imbalance between the two parties. Same goes for insurance. consumer protection laws (governe dby the relevant consumer protection agency. So the lender protexts itself as it writes th contract AND does the things it needs to do to protext itself, but on the approval process, and with later instruments such as insurance. Interestingly., it is the Borrower who pays for this by paying for credit reports etc. So the borrower protects itself by other mechanisms. Caveat emptor - displaced by regulation (the buyer is protected by regulation). Uberimae Fidae - in the utmost good faith. Mortgage Insurance is an additional means of mitigating the risk, that the lended may have., so if the information assessed is not accurate, or if the borrower's situation changes for the worse. then the risk rating may go down. So the Mortgage Insurance is a further strategy which mitigates any shortfall in the Lender Righrs that you may have - ie someone guarantees. In the US you can also avoid that by having paid a deposit. PIMI: Principal, Interst and Morgage Insurance. So the Borrower pays towards the MI, esxcept if they have paid a given amount as deposit. there are 2 types of MI: 1. protects the lender in the event of borrower degault 2. Insurance for "Incapacity to pay the mortage" (these can be bought off the shelf - can combine health, unemployment etc.). - this is the Borrower mitigating their own risk. Prevents foreclosure. Similar to general sickness etc. Where the lender charges for MI, the cost is passed onto the Borrower. e.g. if there is a % valuation (e.g. 70% in Aus, 80% in US for example) then no insurance is required.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Right to fair representation of the facts about Loan products before entrering into agreements for same.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan product disclosure right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: offering related to a loan product that may be a tailored to particular circumstances, aimed at a group of borrowers or individual borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A selection of different types of loan purpose, being the purpose for which and manner in which loan (credit) draw-down amounts are to be used. This shows the purpose for which credit is to be used, and implies certain kinds of fact that relate to that specific type of loan e.g. mortgages. These are also identified as tranche types in tranches of a credit facility.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan purpose

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A loan for the purchase of a boat or other vessel.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: marine finance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: student loan that is not considered a government-backed / regulated loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private student loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: student loan (1) whose lender is a government agency or instrumentality, and/or (2) that is treated uniquely due to tax regulations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulated student loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan provided for the purposes of education, allowing students and parents/guardians to borrow money for college
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: student loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan covering construction and development costs, secured by a mortgage on the property financed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: construction loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: particular kind of construction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: construction type

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: category based on a cultural factors, including nationality, regional culture, ancestry, and language
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ethnicity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a closed-end mortgage loan or open-end line of credit that is not an excluded transaction for HMDA reporting under US section 1003.3(c) of the Revised Home Mortgage Disclosure Act of 2015
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: HMDA covered loan contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a type of action taken regarding an application for a HMDA covered loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: HMDA disposition

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a request for pre-approval of a home purchase loan up to a certain amount, and subject to certain non-credit related conditions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: HMDA pre-approval request

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a report prepared to satisfy HMDA regulatory reporting requirements as described US section 1003.3(c) of the Revised Home Mortgage Disclosure Act of 2015
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: HMDA report

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: category indicating whether the applicant or borrower submitted the application for the covered loan directly to the reporting financial institution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: how submitted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a category based on a person's physical characteristics, such as bone structure and skin, hair, or eye color
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: race

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier given to unequivocally identify a specific loan secured by real estate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: universal loan identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier of amortization algorithms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: amortization type

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: software system that collects the information necessary to approve a loan application and supports a mortgage lender's analysis of a new loan application
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: automated underwriting system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier indicating the extent to which funds are released to the borrower on a new loan origination that refinances an existing loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cash-out status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Examples include closing costs, interest, taxes, and other service-related fees.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: charge category

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier indicating how many dwellings some property has
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dwelling capacity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: category indicating whether the covered loan is secured by a manufactured home only or with land as well
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: manufactured home legal classification

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: insurance-backed guarantee that protects lenders if the mortgage repayments cease for some reason, perhaps due to death or a homeowner being made redundant at work
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage indemnity guarantee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: guarantor and insurer that provides mortgage insurance in the form of a mortgage indemnity guarantee (MIG)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage indemnity guarantor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: insurance policy providing the mortgage indemnity guarantee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage indemnity insurance policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the purpose for which mortgage loan proceeds will be used, such as real property purchase, dwelling construction, or loan refinancing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage loan purpose

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the number permanently assigned by the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) for each company, branch, and individual that maintains a single account on NMLS.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry Identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a category indicating the manner in which the borrower intends to utilize the property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: property usage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan secured by real estate with no ability for the borrower to receive additional funds under the loan at a later date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: closed-end mortgage loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reverse mortgage that provides a lump sum payment to the borrower at closing, with no ability for the borrower to receive additional funds under the mortgage at a later date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: closed-end reverse mortgage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan that, at origination, is secured wholly or substantially by a lien or liens on real property for which the lien or liens are central to the extension of the credit - that is, the borrower would not have been extended credit in the same amount or on terms as favorable without the lien or liens on real property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan secured by real estate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grant of financial interest in real property to a party that is not an owner of that real property and is recorded by a registration authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan secured by real estate with a provision that the outstanding loan amount may be increased upon mutual agreement of the lender and the borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open-end mortgage loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reverse mortgage structured like a home equity line of credit in that it provides the borrower with additional funds after closing (either as fixed monthly payments, under a line of credit, or both)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open-end reverse mortgage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan secured by real estate that pays money to the borrower against a set principal limit based on the value of existing equity in the underlying collateral
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reverse mortgage loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset-backed security that is backed by an underlying pool of auto-related loans and/or leases
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: auto asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt pool of loans and/or leases that are motor vehicle-related
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: auto debt pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt pool of consisting of bonds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured finance securities collateralized by pools of auto loans and leases (auto ABS), credit card receivables (credit card ABS) or student loans (student loan ABS)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset-backed security based on a pool of bonds securitized using a controlled amortization structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlled amortization asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool of credit card receivables associated with designated accounts
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit card account pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset-backed security based on credit card receivables
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit card asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset-backed security based on a pool of debt instruments that returns principal to investors over the life of the security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fully amortizing asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt pool consisting of home equity loans
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: home equity line of credit pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset-backed security based on home equity loan receivables
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: home equity loan asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset-backed security based on student loan receivables
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: student loan asset-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt pool consisting of student loans
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: student loan pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that regularly pays down the principal (face value) on the debt along with its interest expense over the life of the bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: amortizing bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tradable debt instrument representing a loan in which the issuer owes the holder(s) a debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms that include a schedule for repayment of the principal over the lifetime of the bond, typically in equal payments at regular intervals
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond amortization payment terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms indicating when a convertible bond can be converted to another security (usually a publicly traded share issued by of the same issuer)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond conversion terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interest rate on a debt security that the issuer promises to pay to the holder until maturity, expressed as an annual percentage of the face value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond coupon

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: insurance policy that a bond issuer purchases that guarantees the repayment of the principal and all associated interest payments to the bondholders in the event of default
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond insurance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for the repayment of the principal on a bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond principal repayment terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party responsible for maintaining records on behalf of the issuer that identify the owners of a registered bond issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond registrar

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond coupon that has a variable interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond variable coupon

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond with a feature whereby the issue can be partially called for amounts that are at the discretion of the issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond with partial call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whereby amortization is via a known and published schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond with published sinking fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issue whereby the issue includes a warrant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond with warrant

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: taxable municipal bond issued through December 31, 2010 under the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009 (ARRA)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Build America Bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose entire principal value is paid on the maturity date, rather than amortized over its lifetime
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bullet bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for repayment of the principal for a bond as a single payment covering the whole principal amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond bullet principal repayment terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that includes a stipulation allowing the issuer the right to repurchase and retire the bond at the call price after the call protection period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: callable bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convertible bond that is also callable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: callable convertible bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal security available to governing councils in case of emergency, such as a natural disaster, that needs immediate action without time for voter referendum
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: certificate of obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument evidencing a pro rata share in a specific pledged revenue stream, usually lease payments by the issuer that are typically subject to annual appropriation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: certificate of participation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: fixed coupon bond issued by HM Treasury that guarantees to pay the holder of the gilt a fixed cash payment (coupon) every six months until the maturity date, at which point the holder receives the final coupon payment and the return of the principal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: conventional gilt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that gives the holder the right to convert the bond into a fixed number of shares (conversion ratio) if the equity price rises above a specified level (strike price)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: convertible bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued by a company in order to raise financing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for payment of interest on a bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: coupon payment terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond based on the return on an equity over time, i.e. the price and dividend payments or the total return (similar to total return swaps)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equity linked bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provision that gives a bond issuer the right to call its bonds due to an unusual one-time occurrence, as specified in the offering statement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: extraordinary redemption provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheduled date for the first regular coupon payment, in a regular repeating series of coupon periods, after any non standard (long or short) first coupon period in the schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: first regular coupon date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose coupon rate and principal amount are fixed at the time of origination or sale and remain constant while the security is outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed coupon bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for payment of interest on a bond with a fixed interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed coupon terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond with a variable interest rate based on a published reference interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: floating rate note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond secured by an unconditional promise to pay by another entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: full faith credit bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal bond that is backed by the full faith and credit and general resources of the issuing municipality, including its general taxing authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general obligation municipal bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt security issued by a government to fund government spending
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt security issued by some government on behalf of some polity, including sovereign and municipal debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government issued debt security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued specifically to fund climate or environmental projects
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: green bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued by a government sponsored agency or corporation rather than by the government directly
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: implicit full faith credit bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond whose income may vary over time, because either the coupon rate or principal amount is related to a specific index, such as the Consumer Price Index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: index-linked bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond indexed to inflation so that the principal or interest payments rise and fall with the rate of inflation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: inflation-linked bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheduled date of the last regular coupon payment, that is the last of the payments that are made according to a regular repeating series of coupon periods, before any non-standard (long or short) final coupon period in the schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: last regular coupon date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that may be traded on an exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listed bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call allowing the issuer to pay off remaining debt early
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: make whole call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convertible bond that converts into shares at maturity regardless of the equity price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mandatory convertible bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued over time under a shelf registration program, where each issue may have a different coupon and maturity typically ranging from one to ten years
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: medium term note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: government bond that may be issued by a regional, rather than national, authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: official statement specifying how the funds raised via a new issue of municipal securities are to be applied
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal debt funds usage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal securities dealer responsible for reselling to investors securities (such as variable rate demand obligations and other tender option bonds) that have been tendered for purchase by their owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal debt remarketing agent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: official statement identifying the source of funds for a new issue of municipal securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal debt source of funds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term obligation to repay a specified principal amount on a certain date, together with interest at a stated rate, usually payable from a defined source of anticipated revenues
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt obligation issued by a regional governmental entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution with trust powers, designated by the issuer, that acts, pursuant to a bond contract, in a fiduciary capacity for the benefit of the bondholders in enforcing the terms of the bond contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal trustee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interest-bearing bond issued at a deep discount to face value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: original issue discount bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call of part of an issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partial call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call feature whereby the issuer can recall part of the issue on scheduled dates, where bonds are selected to be called according to some rule, or by selecting various bonds at random
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partial call feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention used to determine how the partial call will be actioned with respect to bond selection
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partial redemption allocation convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that has no maturity date, i.e., one that pays interest in perpetuity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: perpetual bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basis for a percentage quoted rate as used in specifying bond call percentage amounts
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rate basis convention

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: repayment event involving payment of a bond's principal amount at maturity or when it is called
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption payment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: repayment schedule whereby a given percentage of a bond issue is redeemed on predefined dates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: call triggered by some regulation-specific rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulatory call

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate bond program where the coupon rate on outstanding bonds is periodically reset through an auction process
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: remarketable bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal bond supported by the revenue from a specific project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: revenue bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that is backed by collateral, such as a tangible asset or income stream, in addition to a general promise to pay
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: secured bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: terms for the paydown of principal in a sinking fund type of amortizing security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sinking fund amortization terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond issued by the government of a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt security issued by the government of a country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign debt instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: municipal bond used to fund a development project that is payable from the revenues of an assessment (tax) on the community that is intended to benefit from the project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special assessment bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond secured by a limited revenue source, such as receipts derived from a designated project
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special obligation bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond secured by revenues derived from designated taxes other than ad valorem taxes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special tax bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond with a coupon that increases (steps up) while the bond is outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step up bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: coupon payment terms for securities with a coupon that increases (steps up) while the bond is outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: stepped coupon terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond that is part of a series of bonds formed by selling each interest payment and the principal amount of a bond as separate zero coupon bonds.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: strip bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: bond payable from the incremental increase in tax revenues realized from any increase in property value and other economic activity, often designed to capture the economic benefit resulting from a bond financing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tax allocation bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term zero coupon treasury obligation with a maturity ranging from one to twelve months
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury bill

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: long term term coupon bearing treasury obligation issued in terms of 20 years or 30 years that pays interest every six months until they mature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: variable income bond whose principal is indexed to inflation or deflation and thus changes over the life of the security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: treasury inflation-protected security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured finance constructed from a portfolio of fixed income assets including corporate loans and mortgage backed securities. A special purpose vehicle (SPV) issues notes to investors in order to raise funds that are invested in a portfolio of those fixed income assets, held by the SPV as collateral for the notes. Further notes: Collateralized Debt Obligation, for example, ABS CDO which consists of a portfolio of different ABS bonds, and the payments to the holders of these trust certificates are derived from the cash flows of the ABS bonds. This CDO instrument is part of a CDO issue, consisting of individual CDO instruments of a given seniority. Often referred to as tranches and slices (Investopedia). Investopedia: Similar in structure to a collateralized mortgage obligation (CMO) or collateralized bond obligation (CBO), CDOs are unique in that they represent different types of debt and credit risk. In the case of CDOs, these different types of debt are often referred to as 'tranches' or 'slices'. Each slice has a different maturity and risk associated with it. The higher the risk, the more the CDO pays. Further details: Collateralized Debt obligations are securitized interests in pools of - generally non-mortgage - assets. Assets - called collateral - usually comprise loans or debt instruments. A CDO may be called a collateralized loan obligation (CLO) or collateralized bond obligation (CBO) if it holds only loans or bonds, respectively. Investors bear the credit risk of the collateral. Multiple tranches of securities are issued by the CDO, offering investors various maturity and credit risk characteristics.
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collateralized debt obligation
